about: Approved increases over the base commit, for tools/bench/compare.mjs. Add  "p5000.typeMiddle": { "ratio": 2, "reason": "...", "issue": "#123" }  in the same commit as the code that makes the figure slower, and remove it when the cost is paid back. Without an entry a figure may not get slower than the base by more than 1.5 times and 2 ms (times) or 1.1 times and 300 KB (bytes).
